data.narrative:
Atlas Motion, a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company, has raised $11.5M to date with leadership from Shield AI and Mach Industries veterans. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes 1 public comparable and 8 private peers spanning various stages and subsectors (Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI among them).

Our valuation analysis employed stage-progression methodology, which proved the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($11.5M) as a proxy for current implied value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage rounds yielded an implied valuation of $29M. A peer-median approach could not be applied—while 10 Robotics & Manufacturing peers exist, insufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables (minimum 3 required) precluded meaningful narrow-set benchmarking.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $24M (low) to $33M (high), with a median of $29M. This range reflects the single-method constraint and is sensitive to two key uncertainties: the appropriateness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for Atlas Motion's specific risk profile and sector dynamics, and the absence of direct peer valuation anchors. Additional comparables or disclosed terms from recent Seed-to-Series A rounds in deep manufacturing robotics would materially improve precision.
